summary: Executed targeted backend+frontend validation for supplier evidence visibility and ESG evidence enforcement. Found one critical backend defect causing 500 on final questionnaire submit when required evidence is missing; other evidence auth/visibility contracts passed.

critical.issue: Final submit without required evidence returns 500 instead of validation error. service.py raises ValueError("Evidence is required for ...") but router.submit_my_answers does not catch it and map to HTTP 400.

ui_bugs.issue: Evidence column header is not rendered when logs are empty because table header is conditionally hidden with empty-state block.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Supplier GHG Logs evidence-column validation
integration_issues.issue: Across tested reporting periods in UI, Logs showed 'No emission records found.'; could not validate Evidence column with live rows even though backend /emissions/all has records when no period filter is used.

integration_issues.flow: Supplier questionnaire evidence controls validation in UI
integration_issues.issue: Supplier had questionnaires, but opened questionnaire rendered 0 evidence control labels; live data did not include optional/required evidence questions in selected questionnaire.

action_items: Handle ValueError from supplier_service.submit_supplier_answers in router.submit_my_answers and return HTTP 400 with detail text.
Re-test final-submit-missing-evidence API to confirm 400 contract behavior.
Confirm expected UI behavior for empty logs state: either always render table headers (including Evidence) or explicitly align acceptance criteria to empty-state rendering.
Provide/seed one supplier questionnaire with evidence_requirement optional/required for deterministic UI validation of evidence controls.
critical_code_review_comments: Router boundary inconsistency: /my-assessment/questionnaires/{id}/answers lacks ValueError->HTTPException mapping unlike many other supplier_assessment routes, causing avoidable 500s.
Error handling should be normalized across supplier_assessment endpoints to prevent business-validation exceptions from escaping as server errors.
Frontend logs table currently hides header in empty states, which weakens testability/UX for verifying newly added columns.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable questionnaire TEST_Evidence_Iter24_* with required/optional evidence questions, uploaded a tiny PDF evidence file, submitted response once, and soft-deleted the questionnaire in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file already covers: parent GHG evidence auth/shape + unauth reject; QuestionCreate evidence_requirement valid/invalid; draft allowed vs final required evidence; supplier/parent evidence ID linkage checks; parent draft-only evidence access denied. One test currently fails due real backend bug (500 instead of 400).
rca of the issue: Repro: supplier posts final submit (is_draft=false,data_verified=true) without required evidence. service.py line ~1307 raises ValueError('Evidence is required for...'). router.py submit_my_answers line ~1124 does not catch ValueError, so FastAPI returns 500. Mitigation: wrap submit_supplier_answers call in try/except ValueError and raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error)); keep 409 lock guard unchanged.
